name: Kachou Fuugetsu ~Koi ni Ochitaru Hanazono no Hime~
original_name: 花鳥風月 ～恋ニヲチタル花園ノ姫～
source:
Issei lost his mother.... He was supposed to join an ordinary school, but he is forced to join Hanamiya School, a girls' school, as a female student. On his first day at school, he meets Anzu, the captain of the student council. Lucky or unlucky, Anzu likes Issei and she appoints him as the executive of the next year's student council.... Well, will he be able to live a peaceful school life? Like this, his strange school life starts....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
一诚失去了母亲…他原本应该进入一所普通学校，却被迫以女生身份进入女子学校花宫学园。入学第一天，他遇见学生会长杏。幸或不幸，杏喜欢上了一诚，还任命他为下一届学生会干部…他能否过上平静的校园生活？一段奇妙的校园生活就此开始…

[摘自ErogeShop]
